messages:
ana: repro note: when we checkpoint during a large prefill the downstream worker sometimes resumes with a one-token KV gap, leading to rope-phase discontinuities in the tail. hit this on orion-20 with magnet-8b-int4.
drew: can you share the exact checkpoint timing relative to prefill boundary? is it during an async flush?
ana: yes, checkpoint triggered by autosave at t=9.8s while prefill still streaming. sequence lengths ~10000, prefill split at 8192. log: `[2026-03-22T02:14:11Z] checkpoint requested, inflight_prefill=320, prefill_split=8192` then later `[2026-03-22T02:14:12Z] KV_GAP detected expected=8192 observed=8191`
vikram: that one-token short is suspicious could be a race where the checkpointed kv_index is written before the final segment commit. does setting `KV_CHECKPOINT_ATOMIC=1` affect it?
ana: toggled atomic checkpointing on and reran: KV_GAP warnings gone, but rot_scale still shifts by tiny epsilon at wrap. maybe two separate issues: a kv sync race and a RoPE rescale rounding at shard join.
drew: try `ROPE_FIX_MODE=stable` in the build that snaps to reference phase on resume. also run with `--seed 3` and `ROPE_DEBUG=1` to log phase counters.
audit-bot: created incident-note ML-CHKPT-21: "checkpoint during prefill causes kv gap + ropescale wobble" https://redwood/incidents/ML-CHKPT-21
vikram: I'll add a short e2e test to the onboarding harness: start prefill stream, trigger mid-prefill checkpoint, resume, assert kv_index monotonic and phase delta < 1e-6. if that fails we fail onboarding.
nana: thanks. attaching minimal repro and kernel traces to the ticket. will follow up after the atomic checkpoint run. :thumbsup:
